Pricing - Estimation Pro AI | Free, Starter & Pro Plans

# Stop losing jobs to slow estimates

Good-Better-Best estimates your client can approve the same day, built from your photos and notes in minutes.

The Spreadsheet Guarantee

Price a real job with EstimationPro. If it doesn't save you time and give you a more complete, better-priced estimate than you'd build yourself with a spreadsheet and Google, email me within 30 days of your first charge and I'll refund every dollar. No forms, no phone tag.

I'm Brad. Third-generation carpenter, 20+ years remodeling, Air Force veteran. I built EstimationPro because I was tired of losing nights pricing jobs at the kitchen table after a 10-hour day.

Every line item, every assembly, every regional multiplier comes from real jobs. If something doesn't match how you actually bid, reply to any email I send and I'll fix it. That's the deal.

## Before you start, here's what most contractors ask me

What if I cancel before the trial ends?

Nothing happens. You won't be charged a dime. Your card sits on file with Stripe so the trial can convert if you want it to, and you can delete it from billing settings anytime. If something glitched and Stripe ever charged you during the trial, email me at support@mail.estimationpro.ai and I'll refund it the same day. No phone tag, no retention pitch. And once you're a paying customer, the 30-day Spreadsheet Guarantee covers your first month too.

Is my data private? Who owns the estimates I generate?

You own them. Every estimate, every client note, every photo. They're yours, exportable as branded PDFs anytime. I don't sell your data, I don't share it with third parties, and I don't train AI models on your jobs. Encrypted at rest, encrypted in transit. If you cancel, you can export everything before you go. I run my own remodeling business, so I treat your data the way I'd want mine treated.

What happens if the AI gets a line item wrong?

Tell me. Reply to any email I send and flag it. I read every one. We push pricing and assembly updates back into the database every week, and your edits inside the app already feed that loop in production. The AI also routes large or complex projects to a stronger model and pulls regional multipliers, so it's not a one-size-fits-all guess. You can edit any line, any markup, any quantity before it goes to the client.

30-day guarantee: saves you time and beats your spreadsheet, or your money back.

The contractor who sends the estimate first wins the job. How many jobs have you lost to a faster competitor?

Brad

Founder & Remodeling Contractor, 20+ years

I built EstimationPro because I needed it myself. After 20+ years running my own remodeling company, I was sick of spending entire evenings writing estimates instead of being with my family. I'd come home from a job site, sit down at the kitchen table, and spend 2-3 hours pricing out a single bathroom remodel.

So I built the tool I wished existed. One where I could snap photos on-site, talk through the scope in my truck, and have a professional estimate ready to send before I even leave the driveway. I use EstimationPro every day in my own business. Every feature exists because I needed it on an actual job.

This isn't a tech company guessing what contractors need. It's a contractor who built exactly what works.
